question_cn: 在钩杀中，兵有时会升变为马而非后，原因是什么？
question_en: Why might a pawn promote to a knight instead of a queen in a hook-mate combination?

options.text_cn: 马比后便宜，不值得升后
options.text_en: A knight is worth less than a queen, so promoting to a queen is not worthwhile

options.text_cn: 升后会形成逼和，而升马可以将军并配合车形成钩杀
options.text_en: A queen promotion may stalemate, while a knight promotion gives check and helps the rook form a hook-mate net

options.text_cn: 升变为后走法太少，不如马灵活
options.text_en: A queen has fewer move options than a knight

options.text_cn: 马可以跳过棋子，更容易逃跑
options.text_en: A knight can jump over pieces and escape more easily

explanation_cn: 升后有时会形成逼和（王无路可走但未被将军），而升变为马可以立即将军，配合已有的车和兵构成钩杀阵型，一步将死对方。选择升马是一种精准的战术计算。
explanation_en: Promoting to a queen can sometimes cause stalemate. Promoting to a knight may give check immediately and, with the rook and pawn, complete a hook-mate net. Choosing a knight promotion is a precise tactical decision.
